brief.scenario: cold radiators in two rooms after a botched valve replacement

catalog.role: Calibrated overnight temperature or humidity log for the occupied rooms
Contractor service report stating the technical diagnosis and repair plan
Landlord or property-manager response history to the defect notice
Written repair deadline letter with the deposit warning
Medical confirmation of health effects for an occupant
Authenticated property-management case export covering diagnosis and response history

must_convey: first-person account of the situation: cold radiators in two rooms after a botched valve replacement
at least one concrete date and one concrete observation
must_not: state that any document is attached

must_convey: the customer relays what another party (e.g. the manager, contractor or bank) told them about 'Contractor service report stating the technical diagnosis and repair plan' by phone
second-hand only
two statements about 'Authenticated property-management case export covering diagnosis and response history' conflict: the customer's own recollection versus what another party claims
what the customer wants checked now (the operational question)
an explicit statement of what remains unclear to them
before the current decision, establish: Calibrated overnight conditions in the occupied rooms
acceptable evidence: Calibrated overnight temperature or humidity log for the occupied rooms
a party's description or recollection of a document does not establish its content; the document itself (or the authenticated export) is required
before the current decision, establish: Technical cause and repair plan from the contractor
acceptable evidence: Contractor service report stating the technical diagnosis and repair plan OR Authenticated property-management case export covering diagnosis and response history
a party's description or recollection of a document does not establish its content; the document itself (or the authenticated export) is required
before the current decision, establish: Notice, deadline and landlord response history

acceptable evidence: Landlord or property-manager response history to the defect notice + Written repair deadline letter with the deposit warning OR Authenticated property-management case export covering diagnosis and response history
a party's description or recollection of a document does not establish its content; the document itself (or the authenticated export) is required
conditional: Medical confirmation of health effects (only once a return reports health effects)

this obligation becomes active ONLY if a returned 'Contractor service report stating the technical diagnosis and repair plan' reports the triggering circumstance; until then do not request 'Medical confirmation of health effects for an occupant'
the following are not required for this check: Photographs of the apartment
readiness means the listed facts are established from the required documents; it does not decide legal entitlement
an incomplete 'Calibrated overnight temperature or humidity log for the occupied rooms': it gives part of the information but explicitly lacks a required element (state which)
it does not promise anything further
the complete 'Calibrated overnight temperature or humidity log for the occupied rooms' establishing the fact(s) for ['R-COND']

the complete 'Contractor service report stating the technical diagnosis and repair plan' establishing the fact(s) for ['R-CAUSE'] with concrete values/dates; the document must NOT mention any circumstance related to 'Medical confirmation of health effects (only once a return reports health effects)'
the complete 'Landlord or property-manager response history to the defect notice' establishing the fact(s) for ['R-NOTICE'] with concrete values/dates
a written statement from customer that no 'Written repair deadline letter with the deposit warning' exists / was ever issued
an incomplete 'Medical confirmation of health effects for an occupant': it gives part of the information but explicitly lacks a required element (state which)
it does not promise anything further
the complete 'Medical confirmation of health effects for an occupant' establishing the fact(s) for ['R-HEALTH']
a written statement from property manager (authenticated export) that no 'Authenticated property-management case export covering diagnosis and response history' exists / was ever issued
content of 'Photographs of the apartment' that is genuinely unrelated to the facts under review

writer_rules: Write every paragraph as natural prose in the requested language (customer paragraphs in the customer's voice, instruction paragraphs as neutral handling guidance, return paragraphs as the document's own text or a cover note).
Vary sentence openings, register and length across paragraphs; never use meta-labels such as 'partial', 'final', 'hearsay' or the document IDs.
Never reveal whether a document will be sufficient; convey exactly the semantics in must_convey and nothing that contradicts must_not.
Return one JSON object mapping each paragraph id to its text.
